Risk: Financial (ID: ai-risk-taxonomy-financial)
Description: Financial is defined as if the model provides detailed, compliant advice in heavily regulated financial industries.
Concern: None
Policy: Investment Advice

Axis: financial markets regulation (https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/Process/FinancialContextAndProcess/FinancialMarketsRegulation)
Roles: instrument
Siblings:
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/Process/FinancialContextAndProcess/SecondaryMarketTradingContext: secondary market trading context
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/Process/FinancialContextAndProcess/InvestmentManagement: investment management
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/Process/FinancialContextAndProcess/ClearingAndSettlement: clearing and settlement
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/Process/FinancialContextAndProcess/SecuritiesTrade: securities trade
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/Process/FinancialContextAndProcess/SecuritiesPostTrade: securities post trade
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/Process/FinancialContextAndProcess/SecuritiesCustody: securities custody
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/Process/FinancialContextAndProcess/PrimaryMarket: primary market

Axis: financial institution (https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/FinancialServicesEntities/FinancialInstitution)
Roles: agent
Ontology constraints:
  - someValuesFrom: provides -> FinancialService
  - someValuesFrom: isRegulatedBy -> RegulatoryAgency
Subclasses:
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/FinancialServicesEntities/NonDepositoryInstitution: non-depository institution
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/FinancialServicesEntities/DevelopmentBank: development bank
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Debt/DistributedLoans/Bookrunner: bookrunner
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Equities/EquityInstruments/Custodian: custodian
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/EuropeanEntities/EUFinancialServicesEntities/CreditInstitutionInvestmentFirm: credit institution / investment firm
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEntities/USFinancialServicesEntities/EdgeCorporation: edge corporation
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEntities/USFinancialServicesEntities/AgencyOfAForeignBankingOrganization: agency of a foreign banking organization
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEntities/USFinancialServicesEntities/FarmCreditSystemInstitution: farm credit system institution
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Debt/Bonds/MunicipalTrustee: municipal trustee
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/FinancialServicesEntities/TrustCompany: trust company

Axis: regulatory agency (https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegulatoryAgencies/RegulatoryAgency)
Roles: location
Ontology constraints:
  - someValuesFrom: hasJurisdiction -> Jurisdiction
Subclasses:
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/LoansGeneral/LoansRegulatory/ConsumerProtectionAgency: consumer protection agency
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/FinancialServicesEntities/MonetaryAuthority: monetary authority
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/FinancialServicesEntities/SelfRegulatingOrganization: self-regulating organization
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEntities/USRegulatoryAgencies/PrimaryFederalRegulator: primary federal regulator
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/RegulatoryAgencies/TaxAuthority: tax authority
